name: Bardic Inspiration
uses: Charisma modifier (minimum 1) per long rest; short rest too from level 5
description: Bonus action: choose another creature within 60 ft that can hear you. It gets a Bardic Inspiration die for the next 10 minutes.

Once in that time, it can roll the die and add the result to one ability check, attack roll or saving throw. It can see its d20 first, but must decide before the DM announces the outcome. A creature holds only one die at a time.
From level 5 a short rest also restores your uses.

name: Song of Rest
uses: Once per short rest, no resource
description: During a short rest, perform soothing music or speech. You and each friendly creature that hears you and regains hit points at the end of that rest gets bonus healing in the die shown.

name: Countercharm
description: Action: start a performance that lasts until the end of your next turn. You and each friendly creature within 30 ft that can hear you have advantage on saves against being frightened or charmed.
It ends early if you are incapacitated or silenced, or if you choose to stop it (no action).

name: Superior Inspiration
trigger: You roll initiative with 0 uses left
description: When you roll initiative and have no Bardic Inspiration uses left, you regain 1 use.

name: Cutting Words
description: When a creature you can see within 60 ft makes an attack roll, ability check or damage roll, spend 1 Bardic Inspiration use and roll the die. Subtract the result from that roll.

You can wait until after the roll, but you must act before the DM says whether it succeeds or before the damage is dealt. Creatures that cannot hear you, or are immune to being charmed, are unaffected.

name: Peerless Skill
description: When you make an ability check, spend 1 Bardic Inspiration use, roll the die and add it to the check.
You can decide after rolling the d20, but before the DM tells you the outcome.

name: Combat Inspiration
trigger: Holder makes a weapon damage roll, or is attacked
description: A creature holding your Bardic Inspiration die can use it in battle, in one of two ways.
Damage: roll the die and add it to a weapon damage roll it just made.
Defense: when an attack targets it, use its reaction to roll the die and add the result to its AC against that attack. It can do this after seeing the attack roll, before learning whether it hits.

name: Battle Magic
trigger: You cast a bard spell with your action
description: Cast a bard spell using your action, and you may then make 1 weapon attack as a bonus action.

name: Mantle of Inspiration
description: Bonus action: spend one Bardic Inspiration use. Pick up to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) creatures within 60 ft; you and each of them must be able to see each other. Each gains temporary hit points (see Temp HP).
Each creature that gains them can at once spend its reaction moving up to its speed; that movement provokes no opportunity attacks.
Temp HP: 5, rising to 8 at level 5, 11 at level 10 and 14 at level 15.

name: Enthralling Performance
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: After you perform for at least 1 minute (song, poem or dance), pick humanoids within 60 ft who saw and heard the whole performance (as many as your Charisma modifier, minimum 1). Each makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC or is charmed by you.
A charmed target adores you: it praises you to anyone who talks with it and gets in the way of your opponents, but it won't turn violent for you unless it already meant to fight on your side.
The charm lasts 1 hour. It ends early if the target takes any damage, if you attack it, or if it sees you attack or hurt one of its allies.
A target that saves never learns you tried to charm it.

name: Mantle of Majesty

spells.uses: Only while the mantle lasts, no slot

description: Bonus action: you take on an unearthly, beautiful fey look for 1 minute, concentrating on it as if on a spell. You cast command at once without using a spell slot.
Until it ends, every turn you can spend a bonus action to cast command again, still with no slot. A creature charmed by you fails its save against these commands automatically.

name: Unbreakable Majesty
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Bonus action: take on a majestic presence. It lasts 1 minute and ends early if you are incapacitated.

The first time on a turn that a creature tries to attack you, it makes a Charisma save against your spell save DC. On a fail it can't attack you this turn: it picks a new target, or the attack is lost. On a success it may attack you, but it has disadvantage on saves against your spells on your next turn.

name: Blade Flourish
trigger: A weapon attack hits during your Attack action
resource: 1 Bardic Inspiration (or a free d6 from level 14)
description: Taking the Attack action on your turn gives you +10 ft of walking speed until the turn ends. If one of that action's weapon attacks hits, you may use one flourish below (only one per turn): spend a Bardic Inspiration use and roll the die.
Defensive Flourish: the roll is extra damage to the target, and you add it to your AC until your next turn starts.
Slashing Flourish: the roll is extra damage to the target and to any other creature you choose within 5 ft of you that you can see.

Mobile Flourish: the roll is extra damage to the target, and you can push it away from you up to 5 ft plus that many feet. Afterward your reaction can carry you, up to your walking speed, into an unoccupied space next to the target (within 5 ft).

name: Master's Flourish
trigger: You use a Blade Flourish option
description: Roll a d6 and use it as the flourish die, so you keep your Bardic Inspiration use.
